source.useBoundary: FerrDb is a third-party, dated, secondary source. Its labels are publication-centric: the same gene may be recorded as driver in one paper and suppressor in another, and both are kept with a per-gene confidence level. Disease links are association-level, not causal. Any number derived from it is a literature count, never a mechanistic claim.
